skill.description: Search the official Aozora Bunko catalog by title, author, or work ID and retrieve plain text from linked literary works.
skill.summary: Find Japanese literary works, inspect catalog metadata, and extract readable text without an API key.

security_audit.summary: Most alerts are harmless Markdown, Japanese text, fixture references, or scoped cache maintenance. Confirmed risks involve unchecked fetch destinations, redirects, and unbounded download or ZIP expansion sizes. No evidence found of prompt injection or credential exfiltration, but the advertised public-domain scope is not enforced.

remediation.issue: Catalog-provided card URLs and HTTP redirects are not restricted before fetching.
remediation.suggestion: Allow only HTTPS URLs on www.aozora.gr.jp with expected paths; reject other schemes, private addresses, and off-domain redirects.

remediation.issue: Responses and ZIP entries are read completely without size or expansion limits.
remediation.suggestion: Bound response bytes and decompressed CSV size; validate entry metadata and compression ratios before reading, and fail cleanly when limits are exceeded.

remediation.issue: Public-domain descriptions conflict with searches and retrieval that include copyrighted works.
remediation.suggestion: Add an explicit public-domain filter, include copyright flags in work-detail output, and describe permissions separately from public-domain status.

content.user_title: Search Aozora Bunko and Extract Literary Text
content.value_statement: Finding Japanese literary texts requires navigating catalog records and inconsistent page encodings. This skill searches the official catalog and extracts readable text from linked works.
actual_capabilities: Search titles by substring and authors by exact concatenated name, with configurable result limits and work-level deduplication.
Return work IDs, titles, kana readings, authors, orthography, copyright flags, first-publication details, and card URLs for search results.
Resolve work IDs through catalog records and extract XHTML, ruby ZIP, and ebook links from book-card pages.
Decode Shift_JIS or UTF-8 XHTML and extract plain text while removing ruby readings and annotation parentheses.
Report catalog rows, distinct works, distinct people, and copyright-flagged work counts.
Cache the official catalog for 24 hours or search a supplied local CSV; limit returned text by character count.
limitations: The catalog is a periodically updated snapshot, not a live inventory; some cards have no available text.
Title spelling must match stored characters, and author searches require exact concatenated names without spaces.
Copyrighted works are included, and retrieval does not enforce public-domain status or establish reuse permission.
Fetched URLs and download sizes lack security limits; character limits only shorten output after the full text is downloaded.

best_practices: Check each work's copyright flag and applicable permissions before reusing or distributing text.
Use trusted catalog data and restrict network destinations when running the helper.
Use exact stored names, preserve six-digit work IDs, and choose character limits for manageable excerpts.
anti_patterns: Treating every catalog entry as public domain or assuming online access grants unrestricted reuse.
Guessing text URLs from work IDs instead of reading the book-card links.
Using catalog row counts as work counts or treating snapshot statistics as current live totals.

faq.question: Does this skill require an API key or account?
faq.answer: No. It reads the public Aozora catalog and linked pages without authentication. The helper uses Python standard-library modules.

faq.question: Can I use it with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: The skill declares support for all three. Running the helper requires Python 3, filesystem access, and network access for remote retrieval.

faq.question: Are all returned works public domain?
faq.answer: No. The catalog includes copyright-flagged works, and the helper does not filter them automatically. Check rights before reuse.

faq.question: Can I search without network access?
faq.answer: Yes. Supply a trusted local catalog CSV for title searches, author searches, or statistics. Card resolution and remote text retrieval still require network access.

faq.question: Why can a title or author search miss a work?
faq.answer: Searches use stored spelling and exact concatenated author names. Historical characters, spaces, or an outdated catalog can affect matches.

faq.question: Does this find current book stock or library holdings?
faq.answer: No. It covers Aozora literary records and available texts, not retail inventory, exhaustive bibliography, or library holdings.
